description: List threads (conversations) for the workspace or a specific agent.

folder.description: Which folder's threads to return, or `all`. Without it: every folder except trash.

label.description: Only threads carrying this label (a name, or a label id `lbl_…`).

mode.description: live for threads that hold live mail, test for threads of test mail only, all for both. Without it: the threads of this connection's own mode.

q.description: Case-insensitive text in the subject or the participants' addresses. For word search across all mail there is mails_search_mail.

read.description: false for unread threads only, true for read ones.

name: mails_list_threads
title: List threads
